reserveReview.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 25540229 (hash 0x050d9c47fab878a8bdd60775f78193c15fb10f514ba6cb80c2ba1982a4721056), the cUSD vault assets() call returned exactly USDC and WTGXX. totalSupplies() returned 55,897,897.772864 USDC and 5,092,033.265897586 WTGXX, which normalized to 91.7% and 8.3%. Their combined configured-dollar value reconciled to 99.9983% of cUSD totalSupply; both live rows therefore have exact tracked identities and reviewed asset classes.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Fixed-block Cap vault totalSupplies by accepted asset, valued at the adapter's configured one-dollar unit values and normalized across the complete assets() enumeration
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The vault's complete assets() enumeration contains only the two identified tracked assets. Borrower and fractional-reserve strategy risk remains a mechanism-level exposure rather than an unidentified reserve slice.
